title: Service Level Agreement | Ironbark Hosting
description: Ironbark Hosting's SLA (effective July 1, 2026): Starter 99.9%, Business 99.95%, Enterprise 99.99% monthly uptime. Service credits apply when uptime falls below the commitment. Business plan: 99.95% monthly uptime. If monthly uptime falls below 99.95%, you receive a service credit of 10% of the monthly fee; below 99.0%, 25%. Starter plan: 99.9% monthly uptime, no service credits. Enterprise plan: 99.99% monthly uptime with credits of up to 50%.

title: Service Level Agreement (archived 2024 version) | Ironbark Hosting
description: Archived SLA, effective January 2024 to June 2026: Business 99.9% monthly uptime with a 5% service credit. Business plan: 99.9% monthly uptime. Service credit: 5% of the monthly fee. This version was replaced on July 1, 2026.

title: Pricing | Ironbark Hosting
description: Starter $12/month, Business $59/month, Enterprise from $499/month. All plans include DDoS protection and daily backups.

title: Uptime SLA - IronBank Hosting
description: IronBank Hosting guarantees 99.99% uptime on every plan, including Business, with a 20% service credit.

title: Ironbark Hosting Business SLA worth it? : r/webhosting
description: Their Business SLA is only 99.9% and the credit is a measly 5%... (posted March 2025)
